description: A real local LLM (m32): on a CPU-only host, the published recipe installs Ollama from its pinned upstream release, points the agent at it, pulls Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct Q4_K_M and activates the runtime after a streaming chat completion. Pass: the run completes and activates llm-serving, the pinned hashes match, a client's chat request is answered, and stop closes the runtime.

optional.opute/units/dbus.service: the user manager starts D-Bus on demand
optional.processes//user.slice/user-1001.slice/us: the user manager starts D-Bus on demand

inputs.agent: the dev VM's production-style system unit opute-bootstrap-mcp.service (Rust 0.5.4 release candidate binary, test identity e2e-devvm-agent, test token); Ollama v0.40.17 and the model are downloaded from upstream during the run

requirements.requirement: A real model runs on the host from the published recipe
requirements.scenario: On a CPU-only host with no Ollama, run_runtime_recipe with activate installs Ollama v0.40.17 from its SHA-256-pinned upstream release, configures the agent to use it, pulls Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct Q4_K_M (the pulled GGUF matches its Hugging Face SHA-256), and activates llm-serving after a streaming chat completion; a client's own chat request is answered

requirements.requirement: The legacy LLM wrappers act on the shared Ollama runtime
requirements.scenario: stop_local_llm_runtime leaves the shared Ollama runtime running and says so; the unit stops through set_host_service_state and its port closes; remove_local_llm_model keeps the shared model and says so, so the pulled model stays on disk until the user removes it

python3 - <<'PY'
import json, time, urllib.request
body = {'model': 'hf.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-GGUF:Q4_K_M', 'stream': True, 'temperature': 0, 'max_tokens': 32, 'messages': [{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Reply with one word: what colour is the sky on a clear day?'}]}
req = urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1/chat/completions', method='POST', data=json.dumps(body).encode(), headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'})
start = time.monotonic(); first = None; text = ''
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as r:
    status = r.status
    for line in r:
        line = line.decode().strip()
        if not line.startswith('data: ') or line == 'data: [DONE]':
            continue
        delta = json.loads(line[6:])['choices'][0].get('delta', {}).get('content') or ''
        if delta and first is None:
            first = time.monotonic()
        text += delta
end = time.monotonic()
print(json.dumps({'status': status, 'answered': bool(text.strip()), 'content': text.strip(), 'firstTokenMs': round((first - start) * 1000), 'totalMs': round((end - start) * 1000)}))
PY
runuser -u opute -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$(id -u opute) systemctl --user is-active opute-ollama.service
